original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. A rule in rules/proposed proposes a candidate that lean-mend accepts at the unsolvedGoals sites of EVMLean Ethereum/Theory/NoOutOfFuel.lean lines 215 and 217, the StopArith and CompBit cases of step_no_OutOfFuel. docs/breaking-changes.md lists the hand repair for these two sites.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. EVMLean run 21 (lean-mend e357c63) left NoOutOfFuel 215 and 217 as residue. The ledger records gaveUp with class unsolvedGoals, case StopArith.ADD at 215 and case CompBit.LT at 217, with h : execBinOp ... in context. Both lines read: cases op <;> intro h <;> simp [step] at h. In the hand bump bcca6b1 (lines 218 and 225) both read: cases op <;> intro h <;> simp only [step, Id.run] at h <;> first | exact execBinOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | exact execTriOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | exact execUnOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | simp_all [step]. rules/proposed has no rule that proposes this text.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. A fixture under tests/ with a lemma of the same shape (cases over an operator type, then intro h and simp [step] at h, where a v4.33.1 simp leaves goals that a per-case lemma closes) shows the rule accepted, through a runner that sources tests/lib/report.sh. Run scripts/gate.sh: stdout is one JSON object; the key 'steps.NoOutOfFuel step cases.ok' is true, and failed is 0.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Spec and Core import no Shell module (scripts/gate.sh checks it). Decision D10 holds: lean-mend adds no declaration to a target. lean-mend depends on Lean core only, not on Mathlib. Every committed text is in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Run export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH" before a lean or lake command. Scratch files go in the gitignored .scratch/ directory, not /tmp. The worker task timeout is 3600 seconds. Do not run lean-mend on EVMLean: the operator runs it after the merge.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) rules/proposed/, docs/rules.md, tests/
restatement: lean-mend must gain a proposed rule that repairs the two unsolvedGoals sites at EVMLean Ethereum/Theory/NoOutOfFuel.lean lines 215 and 217 (the StopArith and CompBit cases of step_no_OutOfFuel). Today both lines read 'cases op <;> intro h <;> simp [step] at h', and lean-mend gives up with unsolvedGoals because no rule in rules/proposed proposes the hand-repair text. The rule must propose the hand-repair from bump bcca6b1: 'cases op <;> intro h <;> simp only [step, Id.run] at h <;> first | exact execBinOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | exact execTriOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | exact execUnOp_no_OutOfFuel _ _ h | simp_all [step]'. The rule is documented in docs/rules.md. A fixture under tests/ with a lemma of the same shape shows the rule accepted through a runner that sources tests/lib/report.sh. The scripts/gate.sh run reports the step 'NoOutOfFuel step cases' ok and zero failures. Constraints: Spec and Core import no Shell module, the rule adds no declaration to a target (D10), and nothing depends on Mathlib. lean-mend is not run on EVMLean.

goal: Add the proposed rule, its documentation and its accepted fixture so that lean-mend can repair the NoOutOfFuel 215/217 sites.

Running the gate script prints a result where the NoOutOfFuel step cases check is true and the failed count is 0.
No new rule or fixture file imports Mathlib.
